title: THE SECRET REVEALED
AT MIDNIGHT
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: midnight silhouette of an ancient stone watchtower against starry sky
deep blue twilight over a calm mystical mountain lake
flickering candle flame inside a dark stone room
vast galaxy night sky with swirling nebulas
open ancient leather bible on a dark wooden table in moonlight
serene silhouette of prayer hands against dark night sky

scenes.a: That question you cannot answer is being solved by the light of heaven right now.
Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision.
Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
Father, bring your clarity into this hidden struggle that weighs upon my spirit tonight.
Let your peace rest upon this room and guide my thoughts toward your perfect truth.
